Messages.Author: Mathieu
Messages.Body:
Just to be sure. Are the following true or false?

- a minion card is controlled by the controler of the minion whom it is
on. (by default)

- a master card is controled by the Meth who played it. (by default)

- if Meth A controls Minion X, plays a Blood Doll, and Meth B takes
control of Minion X, the Blood Doll is still controled by Meth A.

Mathieu

Messages.Author: X_Ze...@email.msn.com
Messages.Body:
In article <39A39B9D...@webmails.com>,


Right Methuselah A still controls the card, but Methuselah B get to
enjoy the benifits of it as per card text.

Put this card on a vampire you control. During his or her master phase,
the Methuselah controlling
the vampire with this card may move 1 blood from the vampire to his
or her blood pool or from his or
her blood pool to the vampire.

So even though Meth A controls the card (ergo. the blood doll will leave
play when A is ousted), it is Methuselah B who controls the vamp it is
on, and therefore it is Methuselah B who can move one blood on or off
the vampire to or from his pool

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> - a minion card is controlled by the controler of the minion whom it is
> on. (by default)

True

> - a master card is controled by the Meth who played it. (by default)

True. Unless it is on a minion.

> - if Meth A controls Minion X, plays a Blood Doll, and Meth B takes
> control of Minion X, the Blood Doll is still controled by Meth A.

False. As soon as control of the minion passes to Meth B, Meth B
controls the Blood Doll and as such, is the only one that can use it
during his/her master phase.

Sorrow

Regarding the question inserted above the context:

No, since they are not master cards. As stated above,
the rules for control of master cards are different
than the rules for control of minion cards.

As above, minion cards (equipment, retainers, etc.)
are controlled by the controller of the minion they
are on (by default).

When a Methuselah is ousted, all cards she controls
are burned. Cards she does not control are not burned
at that time. If she owns any cards controlled by
other players, those cards are returned to her when
they are burned (or at the end of the game if they
last that long).

Messages.Author: X_Ze...@email.msn.com
Messages.Body:
> > - if Meth A controls Minion X, plays a Blood Doll, and Meth B takes
> > control of Minion X, the Blood Doll is still controled by Meth A.
>

> False. As soon as control of the minion passes to Meth B, Meth B
> controls the Blood Doll and as such, is the only one that can use it
> during his/her master phase.

Incorrect, Methuselah A controls the blood doll but by card text the
controller of the vampire with the blood doll on it may move one blood
to or from his blood pool, so therefore Methuselah B gets to enjoy the
use of the blood doll. Unfortunately since the blood doll card is still
controlled by Methuselah A, it will leave play when Methuselah A is
ousted.
